summary.text: Brian Judd of Barre City, an independent, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Governor of Vermont to Phil Scott, receiving 0.8% of the vote to Phil Scott's 52.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
Politics1's candidate listing describes him as an actor and Navy veteran who ran for city council in 2021 and the state House in 2022.
He did not respond to Vermont Public's candidate survey.
